summary: Codex successfully implemented the universal world-anchored floating feedback system. Combat actions accurately map weapon categories (SLASH!, SMASH!, PIERCE!, SHOT!, HIT!), misses, blocks, dodges, actual damage amounts, and high-impact SLAIN! banners anchored to creature tiles. World discoveries (altars, ground items, stairs, traps, shops, portals) anchor directly to map tiles with per-floor session deduplication and line-of-sight visibility enforcement without revealing secret or unexplored data. Visual styling adheres strictly to the dark fantasy palette with non-intercepting pointer events and reduced motion support.

findings.notes: Added overloaded `queue_gameplay_event(coord_def, kind, text, amount, target)` and `queue_discovery(coord_def, target, text)`. Correctly bounds burst sizes to 32 events, checks `you.see_cell(pos)`, and tracks seen discoveries per `level_id` with automatic cleanup on transient branch transitions.

Maps vorpal weapon types cleanly to SLASH!, SMASH!, PIERCE!, and SHOT! with a generic HIT! fallback. Correctly distinguishes defender dodging from attacker missing. Triggers SLAIN! on genuine monster death at the final visible death position while preserving damage and attack labels via lane prioritization.

Accurately detects altars (including Faded Altars), stairs (Up/Down/Escape Hatch), shops, traps, and ground items. Unidentified items and uncollected runes display generic/safe labels without leaking secrets. Only triggers when tiles are actively within player line-of-sight.

Reuses existing requestAnimationFrame loop and canvas projection without creating competing overlays. Implements 20px lane stacking (up to 3 lanes per tile cluster), 200ms duplicate interval filtering, 1250ms lifetime, and slain event candidate displacement so killing blow damage remains readable.

High contrast dark fantasy palette: #f87171 (damage), #ef4444 (player damage/warning), #e5c158 (attack), #94a3b8 (miss/block/dodge), #fbbf24 (slain banner with gold border), #f7d479 (altars/stairs), #34d399 (items), #4ade80 (healing), and #c084fc (spells). Pointer events are disabled to prevent click interference with dungeon tiles, and reduced motion replaces vertical translation with a stationary opacity fade.
9/9 floating events TAP tests passed in floating_events_test.js, 24/24 .ai-team tests passed, and the updated crawl binary (20,601,488 bytes) compiled cleanly under GCC 13.3 in WSL Ubuntu.

recommendations: Commit review record, perform live WebTiles browser verification, push branch to origin, and open Pull Request targeting main.
